Vintage Geological Specimens
Multi-Colored, Various Minerals, 20th Century
A diverse and extensive collection of geological specimens, fossils, and minerals. This lot includes a wide variety of raw and polished materials, spanning from common minerals to paleontological fossils, curated for educational study, lapidary use, or private display.
Items Included:
Natural Gemstone Collection: "Jewels in the Rough" 21-specimen display case
Trilobite Fossil: Peronopsis Interstrictus specimen in an individual protective case
Pyrite Specimens: Multiple large raw crystalline clusters with metallic luster
Mounted Minerals: Approximately 30 specimens on identification cards (includes Beryl, Agate, Iron Ore, and Jasper)
Sea Glass & Pottery: Assorted weathered fragments and historical pottery shards
Loose Gemstones: Large lot of tumbled and raw stones including Rose Quartz and Amethyst
Condition:

275834660.description: This lot includes a variety of natural mineral and gemstone specimens weighing 7.6 lbs. The collection primarily features several raw amethyst crystal clusters and geodes of various sizes, ranging from a few inches to over 8 inches across. The amethyst crystals exhibit rich purple hues, with some specimens containing calcite inclusions or iron oxide staining. Also included is a unique gemstone tree sculpture made with amethyst chips and copper wire, as well as a decorative piece with a metal Pegasus figurine mounted on an amethyst base. All items are in good used condition, showing natural variations and minor edge wear typical of mineral specimens.
